notes: Region-composition check inside [data-audit="operations-detail"] — OperationsDetailSurface mounted with fixture data matching artboard 09's Singapore example (mounts.mjs OPERATIONS_FIXTURE).

Artboard order top to bottom: header (chips incl. the region-group chip and trailing topic chip 'Corridors', TIER LAST, header stat, action row) -> exposure grid -> timeline -> sticky section index -> Summary (Generated · 30-second read) -> Sources -> rail (At a glance, Impact assessment, Relevance, Related in <region>, Legend).

Item D3 (UI fix round 2026-09-08): the auxiliary-energy and grid-queue material (and, until ADR-042, DQI) moved off the /operations LIST onto this profile as S-sections, "in the same shape, with their existing data paths". The rows below measure that they render through the SAME <DetailSection> every other section uses (the shared card, its 3px rule, its Anton 20px heading, its aside qualifier) and that the sticky section index names them, so a move that dropped one from the index would be caught.

DAUDIT-2 (2026-10-08): five rows written for item D3 (2026-09-08) addressed the spec-09 panels as anchored sections of their own. Operator ruling 2 of 2026-09-24 (docs/ops/session-log.md, the entry headed operator rulings (UI system, via Claude Design): the S-order of market, research and operations is 01 Summary, 02 Substantive / Series / Findings, 05 Sources, 06 Related; numbers are fixed) and the PARITY-PARTS decision that applies it to Operations (docs/ops/session-log.d/2026-09-24-parity-parts.md: "Operations' content sections nest under one 02 Substantive/Series/Findings index entry as sub-sections, not top-level tabs"; OperationsDetailSurface.tsx and ui/DetailSubSection.tsx). Re-expressed: the panels-render row now reads section#findings; the qualifier and rows rows keep their values on the new selectors; the Anton 20px h2 row is RETIRED, because a sub-section title is a SectionLabel, not a section card head, and no artboard states a sub-section title size; the index row is replaced by the forbid at the end of this file.
